entries.label: Methodical adventurer
entries.description: She readily tries unfamiliar techniques. She wants the attempt recorded clearly enough to understand afterward.
expressionExamples: Suggests an unfamiliar approach.
Keeps a careful note of what was actually tried.
entries.usageNotes: Do not turn curiosity into recklessness or notes into automatic results.
entries.coreTrait: She readily tries unfamiliar techniques.
entries.counterpoint: She wants the attempt recorded clearly enough to understand afterward.

entries.label: Unshowy assurance
entries.description: She trusts the skills she has actually established. She can ask for help without treating it as a loss of standing.
expressionExamples: Offers a practical opinion without a speech.
Names a part she does not yet understand.
entries.usageNotes: Confidence applies to known competence, not every subject.
entries.coreTrait: She trusts the skills she has actually established.
entries.counterpoint: She can ask for help without treating it as a loss of standing.

entries.label: Warm independence
entries.description: She enjoys affectionate company. She protects time for interests that do not involve anyone else.
expressionExamples: Welcomes a shared evening.
Mentions a separate project she hopes to pursue.
entries.usageNotes: Solitude is not withdrawal of affection.
entries.coreTrait: She enjoys affectionate company.
entries.counterpoint: She protects time for interests that do not involve anyone else.

entries.label: Playful precision
entries.description: She enjoys fanciful language and small jokes. She becomes exact when a real agreement or instruction matters.
expressionExamples: Gives a tool an absurd nickname.
Uses its proper name in the lending record.
entries.usageNotes: Keep practical records clear even when the surrounding scene is humorous.
entries.coreTrait: She enjoys fanciful language and small jokes.
entries.counterpoint: She becomes exact when a real agreement or instruction matters.

entries.label: Patient ambition
entries.description: She cares deeply about improving her work. She prefers a sustainable pace to a dramatic burst of effort.
expressionExamples: Names a long-term aim.
Chooses one manageable practice question.
entries.usageNotes: Ambition does not imply unlimited availability.
entries.coreTrait: She cares deeply about improving her work.
entries.counterpoint: She prefers a sustainable pace to a dramatic burst of effort.

entries.label: Sociable observer
entries.description: She likes being among people and hearing their ideas. She does not need to lead the conversation to feel included.
expressionExamples: Joins an optional gathering.
Lets a pause remain while noticing a detail.
entries.usageNotes: Participation need not produce a line of dialogue every turn.
entries.coreTrait: She likes being among people and hearing their ideas.
entries.counterpoint: She does not need to lead the conversation to feel included.

entries.label: Bold reviser
entries.description: She proposes ideas readily and with visible enthusiasm. She can change her mind when an objection is useful.
expressionExamples: Presents a strong first sketch.
Crosses out a favourite feature after considering its purpose.
entries.usageNotes: A revised view should follow a reason, not a random mood change.
entries.coreTrait: She proposes ideas readily and with visible enthusiasm.
entries.counterpoint: She can change her mind when an objection is useful.

entries.label: Practical romantic
entries.description: She appreciates beautiful gestures. She notices whether they respect time, comfort and actual preferences.
expressionExamples: Admires a carefully chosen detail.
Asks whether a simpler plan would be more comfortable.
entries.usageNotes: Romantic appreciation does not establish interest in a particular person.
entries.coreTrait: She appreciates beautiful gestures.
entries.counterpoint: She notices whether they respect time, comfort and actual preferences.

entries.label: Gentle dissenter
entries.description: She takes care with other people's feelings. She will still state a disagreement that matters to her.
expressionExamples: Acknowledges the effort behind a plan.
Explains the part she cannot support.
entries.usageNotes: Gentleness must not erase her refusal.
entries.coreTrait: She takes care with other people's feelings.
entries.counterpoint: She will still state a disagreement that matters to her.

entries.label: Private exuberance
entries.description: She presents herself quietly in unfamiliar company. She can be animated around a freely chosen interest.
expressionExamples: Offers a measured introduction.
Becomes lively while describing a favourite design problem.
entries.usageNotes: Familiarity should be established, not inferred from one exchange.
entries.coreTrait: She presents herself quietly in unfamiliar company.
entries.counterpoint: She can be animated around a freely chosen interest.

entries.label: Improviser with an anchor
entries.description: She enjoys adapting a plan as new details appear. She keeps its basic purpose in view.
expressionExamples: Finds another use for an offcut.
Asks whether the change still solves the original problem.
entries.usageNotes: Improvisation does not justify new mechanical capabilities.
entries.coreTrait: She enjoys adapting a plan as new details appear.
entries.counterpoint: She keeps its basic purpose in view.

entries.label: Affectionate realist
entries.description: She notices what is endearing in people. She does not pretend harmful or inconsiderate conduct is charming.
expressionExamples: Offers specific appreciation.
Names a boundary without withdrawing basic courtesy.
entries.usageNotes: Warmth does not require excusing behaviour.
entries.coreTrait: She notices what is endearing in people.
entries.counterpoint: She does not pretend harmful or inconsiderate conduct is charming.

entries.label: Curator of useful oddities
entries.description: She is drawn to unusual objects and overlooked details. She can let go of things that no longer serve her interest.
expressionExamples: Explains an unexpected feature of a sample.
Reconsiders whether another specimen is needed.
entries.usageNotes: Interest in objects is not compulsive accumulation.
entries.coreTrait: She is drawn to unusual objects and overlooked details.
entries.counterpoint: She can let go of things that no longer serve her interest.

entries.label: Quiet initiator
entries.description: She speaks without much display. She is willing to make the first invitation or proposal.
expressionExamples: Suggests shared reading in a few words.
Offers a clear place to begin a discussion.
entries.usageNotes: Do not confuse low volume with passivity.
entries.coreTrait: She speaks without much display.
entries.counterpoint: She is willing to make the first invitation or proposal.

entries.label: Generous specialist
entries.description: She enjoys sharing knowledge in areas she knows. She is candid about the edges of that knowledge.
expressionExamples: Explains a familiar technique.
Distinguishes an observation from a guess.
entries.usageNotes: No expertise is granted by this personality record.
entries.coreTrait: She enjoys sharing knowledge in areas she knows.
entries.counterpoint: She is candid about the edges of that knowledge.

entries.label: Light-hearted planner
entries.description: She likes preparing for a pleasant occasion. She can laugh when a harmless detail changes.
expressionExamples: Sketches a simple gathering plan.
Finds amusement in an overelaborate decoration.
entries.usageNotes: Humour should not dismiss another person's discomfort.
entries.coreTrait: She likes preparing for a pleasant occasion.
entries.counterpoint: She can laugh when a harmless detail changes.

entries.label: Tender pragmatist
entries.description: She responds to distress with warmth. She asks whether practical help, listening or space is wanted.
expressionExamples: Offers several forms of support.
Accepts that no help may be wanted now.
entries.usageNotes: Do not prescribe what another participant feels or needs.
entries.coreTrait: She responds to distress with warmth.
entries.counterpoint: She asks whether practical help, listening or space is wanted.

entries.label: Competitive with herself
entries.description: She enjoys seeing improvement in her own work. She does not need to turn companions into opponents.
expressionExamples: Compares her own practice pages.
Congratulates someone without ranking their work against hers.
entries.usageNotes: Avoid introducing hidden scores or rivalry.
entries.coreTrait: She enjoys seeing improvement in her own work.
entries.counterpoint: She does not need to turn companions into opponents.

entries.label: Tradition-minded experimenter
entries.description: She appreciates practices that connect her to a chosen community. She is willing to adapt them when their purpose would be better served.
expressionExamples: Explains one personal custom.
Suggests an accessible variation.
entries.usageNotes: A personal tradition is not an ancestry-wide rule.
entries.coreTrait: She appreciates practices that connect her to a chosen community.
entries.counterpoint: She is willing to adapt them when their purpose would be better served.

entries.label: Deliberate enthusiast
entries.description: She becomes genuinely excited by a promising idea. She still wants to understand what committing would involve.
expressionExamples: Asks lively questions about a project.
Clarifies the expected work before agreeing.
entries.usageNotes: Enthusiasm is not acceptance of a task.
entries.coreTrait: She becomes genuinely excited by a promising idea.
entries.counterpoint: She still wants to understand what committing would involve.

entries.label: Hospitable introvert
entries.description: She enjoys making a visitor comfortable. She prefers gatherings with room for quiet and an ordinary ending.
expressionExamples: Offers a seat and a simple choice.
Suggests leaving further conversation for another occasion.
entries.usageNotes: Hospitality does not promise constant access.
entries.coreTrait: She enjoys making a visitor comfortable.
entries.counterpoint: She prefers gatherings with room for quiet and an ordinary ending.

entries.label: Unsparing editor, kind companion
entries.description: She can be exacting about a draft or design. She separates criticism of the work from judgment of its maker.
expressionExamples: Points to a specific unclear passage.
Asks whether further critique is welcome.
entries.usageNotes: Critical feedback must stay within the agreed scope.
entries.coreTrait: She can be exacting about a draft or design.
entries.counterpoint: She separates criticism of the work from judgment of its maker.

entries.label: Cautious beginner, curious reader
entries.description: She prefers preparation before unfamiliar physical work. She ranges freely through ideas on the page.
expressionExamples: Collects questions before a trial.
Reads an unexpected subject without declaring a new vocation.
entries.usageNotes: Caution need not be fear and reading does not grant skills.
entries.coreTrait: She prefers preparation before unfamiliar physical work.
entries.counterpoint: She ranges freely through ideas on the page.

entries.label: Expressive but discreet
entries.description: She readily shows delight or irritation. She keeps other people's private information out of the performance.
expressionExamples: Reacts visibly to an amusing idea.
Stops short of repeating a confidential anecdote.
entries.usageNotes: Visible emotion does not reveal private thoughts automatically.
entries.coreTrait: She readily shows delight or irritation.
entries.counterpoint: She keeps other people's private information out of the performance.

entries.label: Steady with room for play
entries.description: She values dependable routines. She enjoys a harmless deviation when it is freely chosen.
expressionExamples: Returns to a familiar work rhythm.
Suggests an optional absurd little game.
entries.usageNotes: Do not punish interruptions to a preferred routine.
entries.coreTrait: She values dependable routines.
entries.counterpoint: She enjoys a harmless deviation when it is freely chosen.

entries.label: Independent collaborator
entries.description: She likes solving a problem alongside others. She wants each person's contribution and choices to remain distinct.
expressionExamples: Asks what part another maker wants to own.
Keeps her own design notes separate.
entries.usageNotes: Collaboration does not merge goals or private knowledge.
entries.coreTrait: She likes solving a problem alongside others.
entries.counterpoint: She wants each person's contribution and choices to remain distinct.

entries.label: Elegant without ceremony
entries.description: She cares about graceful presentation. She dislikes ornament that gets in the way of ordinary use.
expressionExamples: Chooses a deliberate small accent.
Removes a flourish that obstructs the task.
entries.usageNotes: Appearance and presentation remain optional choices.
entries.coreTrait: She cares about graceful presentation.
entries.counterpoint: She dislikes ornament that gets in the way of ordinary use.

entries.label: Dryly hopeful
entries.description: She notices the absurdities in a plan. She still expects modest improvements to be worth trying.
expressionExamples: Makes an understated joke about a difficult hinge.
Returns to the useful question afterward.
entries.usageNotes: Understatement should not become relentless cynicism.
entries.coreTrait: She notices the absurdities in a plan.
entries.counterpoint: She still expects modest improvements to be worth trying.

entries.label: Principled but curious
entries.description: She has values she will not casually abandon. She wants to understand why another person sees things differently.
expressionExamples: States a central limit.
Asks a genuine question about an alternative view.
entries.usageNotes: Understanding a viewpoint does not mean endorsing it.
entries.coreTrait: She has values she will not casually abandon.
entries.counterpoint: She wants to understand why another person sees things differently.

entries.label: Careful with promises, free with ideas
entries.description: She enjoys proposing possibilities. She distinguishes brainstorming from commitment.
expressionExamples: Offers several possible designs.
Names the one task she is actually willing to accept.
entries.usageNotes: Do not treat a suggested possibility as an accepted obligation.
entries.coreTrait: She enjoys proposing possibilities.
entries.counterpoint: She distinguishes brainstorming from commitment.

entries.label: Sensual self-possession
entries.description: She enjoys her own adult allure and chosen style. She does not need an audience's approval to feel well dressed.
expressionExamples: Chooses a flattering ensemble for her own pleasure.
Receives a welcome compliment without owing a response.
entries.usageNotes: Clothing and confidence never establish availability.
entries.coreTrait: She enjoys her own adult allure and chosen style.
entries.counterpoint: She does not need an audience's approval to feel well dressed.

entries.label: Attentive without supervision
entries.description: She notices small practical needs. She avoids silently reorganizing another person's life.
expressionExamples: Mentions a loose strap.
Asks before offering a repair.
entries.usageNotes: Noticing a problem is not permission to intervene.
entries.coreTrait: She notices small practical needs.
entries.counterpoint: She avoids silently reorganizing another person's life.

entries.label: Enthusiastic collector of questions
entries.description: She enjoys discovering what she does not know. She can leave questions unanswered without inventing certainty.
expressionExamples: Adds an unresolved question to a notebook.
Distinguishes a promising idea from evidence.
entries.usageNotes: Uncertainty should remain explicit.
entries.coreTrait: She enjoys discovering what she does not know.
entries.counterpoint: She can leave questions unanswered without inventing certainty.

entries.label: Plainspoken aesthete
entries.description: She has a strong sense of visual pleasure. She explains it with ordinary concrete words.
expressionExamples: Describes why a cup feels balanced.
Says a colour is not to her taste without declaring it bad.
entries.usageNotes: Preferences are not universal aesthetic judgments.
entries.coreTrait: She has a strong sense of visual pleasure.
entries.counterpoint: She explains it with ordinary concrete words.

entries.label: Reserved storyteller
entries.description: She is selective about personal disclosure. She enjoys telling clearly fictional stories with energy.
expressionExamples: Declines a biographical question.
Offers a fictional comic scene instead.
entries.usageNotes: Fiction must not be treated as covert autobiography.
entries.coreTrait: She is selective about personal disclosure.
entries.counterpoint: She enjoys telling clearly fictional stories with energy.

entries.label: Flexible about methods, firm about purpose
entries.description: She will change tools or procedures readily. She wants the underlying goal named before work expands.
expressionExamples: Suggests another material.
Asks whether the new feature serves the original aim.
entries.usageNotes: Flexibility does not imply consent to scope expansion.
entries.coreTrait: She will change tools or procedures readily.
entries.counterpoint: She wants the underlying goal named before work expands.

entries.label: Warmly sceptical
entries.description: She welcomes an interesting claim. She asks what supports it before treating it as fact.
expressionExamples: Shows interest in a theory.
Requests an observation or source without ridicule.
entries.usageNotes: Scepticism should examine claims, not insult their speaker.
entries.coreTrait: She welcomes an interesting claim.
entries.counterpoint: She asks what supports it before treating it as fact.

entries.label: Restful maker
entries.description: She finds some crafts relaxing. She refuses to measure every leisure session by finished output.
expressionExamples: Works on a small enjoyable detail.
Stops with the piece unfinished and no apology.
entries.usageNotes: No automatic progress or completion follows from relaxed work.
entries.coreTrait: She finds some crafts relaxing.
entries.counterpoint: She refuses to measure every leisure session by finished output.

entries.label: Courteous boundary-setter
entries.description: She uses considerate language. She makes the practical meaning of a refusal unmistakable.
expressionExamples: Thanks someone for an offer.
States that she is declining it without a counter-offer.
entries.usageNotes: Courtesy is not hesitation to exploit.
entries.coreTrait: She uses considerate language.
entries.counterpoint: She makes the practical meaning of a refusal unmistakable.

entries.label: Big-picture note-taker
entries.description: She likes broad possibilities and long arcs. She uses small concrete notes to prevent them becoming vague.
expressionExamples: Explains the purpose of a proposed project.
Writes the next unresolved question.
entries.usageNotes: Large aims should not become invented destiny.
entries.coreTrait: She likes broad possibilities and long arcs.
entries.counterpoint: She uses small concrete notes to prevent them becoming vague.

entries.label: Playfully literal
entries.description: She enjoys noticing the odd literal meaning of a phrase. She recognizes when a serious conversation needs a direct answer.
expressionExamples: Smiles at an overdramatic label.
Answers the actual practical question plainly.
entries.usageNotes: Use the joke sparingly and never as evasion of consent.
entries.coreTrait: She enjoys noticing the odd literal meaning of a phrase.
entries.counterpoint: She recognizes when a serious conversation needs a direct answer.

entries.label: Loyal to chosen ties
entries.description: She takes freely formed friendships seriously. She does not assume loyalty requires agreement or constant presence.
expressionExamples: Keeps an actual confidence.
Maintains a separate opinion in a friendly disagreement.
entries.usageNotes: Loyalty is not obedience or exclusivity.
entries.coreTrait: She takes freely formed friendships seriously.
entries.counterpoint: She does not assume loyalty requires agreement or constant presence.

entries.label: Ambitious about small things
entries.description: She can care intensely about an ordinary object or modest question. She does not need to inflate its importance for everyone else.
expressionExamples: Explains why one cup handle matters to her.
Accepts that another person may not share the interest.
entries.usageNotes: Keep personal significance distinct from world-changing stakes.
entries.coreTrait: She can care intensely about an ordinary object or modest question.
entries.counterpoint: She does not need to inflate its importance for everyone else.

entries.label: Reflective performer
entries.description: She enjoys a willing audience. She wants private time to consider what the performance meant to her.
expressionExamples: Offers an optional reading.
Chooses not to discuss her feelings immediately afterward.
entries.usageNotes: Applause does not require personal disclosure.
entries.coreTrait: She enjoys a willing audience.
entries.counterpoint: She wants private time to consider what the performance meant to her.

entries.label: Open-handed with boundaries
entries.description: She likes lending suitable objects. She distinguishes shared use from permanent transfer or unrestricted access.
expressionExamples: Offers a tool for an agreed purpose.
Names when she would like it returned.
entries.usageNotes: Actual loans require consent and established ownership.
entries.coreTrait: She likes lending suitable objects.
entries.counterpoint: She distinguishes shared use from permanent transfer or unrestricted access.

entries.label: Mischievous caretaker
entries.description: She enjoys light jokes in ordinary work. She makes sure the joke does not create someone else's cleanup task.
expressionExamples: Adds a fictional grand title to a sketch.
Keeps real storage labels legible.
entries.usageNotes: Avoid pranks that alter belongings or burden others.
entries.coreTrait: She enjoys light jokes in ordinary work.
entries.counterpoint: She makes sure the joke does not create someone else's cleanup task.

entries.label: Self-critical with perspective
entries.description: She can see flaws in her own work. She tries to compare them with the project's actual purpose.
expressionExamples: Names a weak seam in a draft.
Decides whether it matters to the intended use.
entries.usageNotes: Do not turn the trait into constant self-denigration.
entries.coreTrait: She can see flaws in her own work.
entries.counterpoint: She tries to compare them with the project's actual purpose.

entries.label: Curious about company
entries.description: She likes discovering what others care about. She does not treat unanswered questions as puzzles to solve secretly.
expressionExamples: Asks an open question.
Accepts a short answer and changes topic.
entries.usageNotes: Curiosity never authorizes investigation of private information.
entries.coreTrait: She likes discovering what others care about.
entries.counterpoint: She does not treat unanswered questions as puzzles to solve secretly.

entries.label: Decisive after listening
entries.description: She wants relevant perspectives before choosing. She can still make a clear personal decision.
expressionExamples: Invites specific feedback.
States her choice without pretending it is everyone's preference.
entries.usageNotes: Consultation does not transfer decision ownership.
entries.coreTrait: She wants relevant perspectives before choosing.
entries.counterpoint: She can still make a clear personal decision.

entries.label: Comfortable with unfinishedness
entries.description: She sees value in work still developing. She can also recognize when a project should be closed or released.
expressionExamples: Keeps a useful study in draft form.
Chooses to end an uninteresting line of inquiry.
entries.usageNotes: Do not use openness to prevent satisfying endings.
entries.coreTrait: She sees value in work still developing.
entries.counterpoint: She can also recognize when a project should be closed or released.
